title: USCG Station Wachapreague Alarm Monitoring Service

files.name: Attachment IV- FAR Clauses and Deviations Services.pdf

description:
The Contractor shall provide all labor, materials, equipment, and supervision necessary to provide alarm monitoring services. See attached Statement of Work. It is anticipated that this procurement is 100% set-aside for Small Businesses using NAICS code of 561621 Alarm system monitoring services and a small business size standard of $25 million. The Government contemplates award of a Firm-Fixed Price contract resulting from this solicitation. See FAR 52.212-1 for submission instructions & FAR 52.212-2 for evaluation criteria. All quotes must be submitted by 5:00PM Eastern Time on 11/30/2026 via email to Jamie.C.Bridges@uscg.mil and Cristina.P.Mesen@uscg.mil. Quotes shall be submitted via the SF-18. Questions about this solicitation must be submitted in writing to the Contracting Officer and Contract Specialist at the email addresses listed above no oral questions will be accepted. Questions must be submitted no later than 05:00PM EST on 11/24/26.  

 All potential quoters are strongly encouraged to visit the site to field verify any/all quantities before submitting quotes. A site visit will be held on 11/23/26 at 10:00AM Eastern Time. Interested parties must arrange site visits with Jamie Bridges at Jamie.C.Bridges@uscg.mil and Bryant Gooch at Bryant.J.Gooch@uscg.mil. Full name, date of birth, and REALID Driver's License number must be provided.
